integrity_notes: The infinite-family proof uses a bijective rank and checks both input transitions for every pair. A self-contained finite checker independently computes shortest distances and multiplicities, but finite tests are not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The known extremal maximum already implies the unlabelled multiplicity-one pair distance spectrum; no novelty is claimed for that corollary. The new claims are exact labeled distances and uniqueness of all shortest pair words for the canonical Černý family only. A historical equivalent explicit pair-path description might exist.
title: Unique optimal pair-merging words and an explicit pair-distance labeling for the Černý automata
